history.summary: Plan complete and parsing: five phases (decision record, ArgoCDDeploy render gate, Charts library ConfigMap, FieldnotesDeploy bump, estate rollout) and 10 criteria. Two questions: Q1, who publishes the new library to charts.home mid-run, since the deploy-repo phases cannot lock or gate before it and no ruling authorizes an in-phase push (recommend P4 pushes Charts' reviewed main); Q2, confirm that the rollout's pushes belong to the test phase after the live proof.

Rulings D3/D4 applied; the plan was already written to them. The pass also brought the plan in line with slice 039, closed ad hoc this morning, which stopped vendoring the library: P5, V08 and the ordering now give ChartsDeploy and RegistryDeploy the plain bump, with ChartsDeploy pushed last on its own. Close-out A1 (before /dev:run-slice) asks the operator to push 039's three unpushed commits, in Charts, ChartsDeploy and RegistryDeploy.

One blocking finding: KubeCoderDeploy's own gate hard-codes homelab-shared 0.3.1 (tests/render-chart.py:26, check_library), so the plan's 'pin and lock, nothing else' bump is false there, and nothing in the run runs the bumped repos' gates to catch it. One advisory: ruling D2's sequencing is superseded by D4 but left standing. The mechanism, the reach, the pins and the AC mapping hold.
